definitions.full: H6705. tsachach [ צָחַח ] verb be dazzling ( צַחְצַח ᵑ7 polish ; Syriac be scorched , Aph`el declare in writing (make clear), clarus, lucidus, fulgidus ; , , smooth, plain ); — Qal Perfect 3plural מֵחָלָב צַחוּ Lam 4:7 (|| מִשֶּׁלֶג זַכּוּ ), they are more dazzling (i.e. whiter ) than milk (of effeminate skin).
